resources.string: Reads the text of TikTok comments so it can redraw them in Noto Sans. Text from other apps is never read.
Redraws TikTok\'s Russian comments in Noto Sans, in place.
No screen recording and no OCR. The comment text is read directly from TikTok\'s view hierarchy, so what you see is the real text — not a guess at what the broken glyphs said.
Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → CyrFix → turn on. This is the only permission normally needed.
Usually not required. Grant it only if the floating button never appears over TikTok.
A round Аа button appears at the edge of the screen. Drag it anywhere. Tap once to correct the comments, tap again to stop.
Patches must be opaque to hide the original glyphs, so this has to match TikTok\'s sheet colour.
Outlines every text node instead of redrawing it, and records what the service can see. Use this if nothing gets corrected.
Ignores the comment-sheet detection and corrects every Cyrillic string on screen.
No dump yet — turn on diagnostic mode, open TikTok comments, then come back.
